title: EstimatorTable
description: Shape of packages/spec/estimator.json, the run estimator's fitted coefficients (ARCHITECTURE.md, Estimator; ADR-049). Written by worker/benchmarks/solver/fit.py from the benchmark data; never edited by hand. Every quantity is SI: bytes and seconds.

version.description: Bumped whenever a coefficient changes, so a run's frozen estimate says which fit made it.

source.description: Where the fit's data came from, for people.

analyses.description: One model per analysis type a run can have.

memoryMargin.description: Factor on the fitted peak memory that a machine size must hold before it is recommended. Recommendations are conservative on memory, because the platform pays when its recommendation is too small (ARCHITECTURE.md).

usableMemoryFraction.description: Share of a machine size's memory the solver may use; the rest is left to the system and the worker.

limitMemoryBytes.description: Memory of the machine the element limits are for (ADR-063): 16 GiB in Phase 0. A run whose mesh has more elements than its solver's limit is refused.

SolverModels.description: One model per equation solver a run can use (ADR-063), keyed as SimulationSpec's solver.

solver.description: The solver and threads the fit was measured with.

peakMemoryBytes.description: Peak resident memory of the solver process.

jobSeconds.description: Wall time of the solve job's billable phase: writing the deck, the solver, reading results and writing the viewer's files.

fittedNodes.description: Smallest and largest node count among the measurements; outside this range the estimate is an extrapolation.

maxElements.description: Largest element count a run with this solver may have, per element order, on a machine of limitMemoryBytes: the node count whose fitted peak memory times memoryMargin fits in usableMemoryFraction of it, turned into elements with the nodes per element of the measured mesh nearest it, at most the largest mesh measured, rounded down to a thousand.

PowerLaw.description: constant + coefficient * nodes ^ exponent, where nodes is the mesh's node count.

largestRatio.description: Largest measured value over the fitted one among the measurements: how far the fit fell short at worst.
